1ST COMPANY TASK FORCE._engine_note: Verified from corpus (2026-08-23). Once per battle, in your Command phase, activate until your next Command phase: friendly models with Oath of Moment may re-roll Wound rolls when attacking the army's Oath of Moment target. Not modelled: once-per-battle activation, not always-on; only applies while attacking the declared Oath of Moment target; expires at start of next Command phase

ANVIL SIEGE FORCE._engine_note: Verified from corpus (2026-08-23). All army ranged weapons gain the Heavy ability (penalty to Hit when the unit moved). Weapons that already had Heavy instead add +1 to Wound rolls made by units that Remained Stationary that turn. Not modelled: +1 to Wound is conditional on weapon already having Heavy AND unit Remaining Stationary (not broadly always-on); Heavy keyword imposes a movement penalty to Hit rolls (negative effect, outside vocabulary)

ARMOURED SPEARTIP._engine_note: Verified from corpus (2026-08-23). Units disembarking from a Transport that made a Normal or Advance move this phase (not from Strategic Reserves) may make a bonus Normal move of up to D6", or D3+3" if the Transport is a Heavy Transport (vehicle Transports with 14+ Wounds). Not modelled: bonus move is post-disembark only and dice-based (D6/D3+3), not a characteristic bonus; requires the Transport itself to have moved this phase

BLACK SPEAR TASK FORCE._engine_note: Verified from corpus (2026-08-23). Deathwatch-restricted army list (no other Chapters; excluded generic Astartes units). Each Command phase select one active Mission Tactics, each usable once per battle, affecting units whose datasheets natively list the ability: Furor grants Sustained Hits 1; Malleus grants Lethal Hits; Purgatus grants Precision on Critical Hits. Not modelled: choose-one rotating buff, not always-on; options: Sustained Hits 1 / Lethal Hits / Precision on Critical Hits; each tactic selectable only once per battle; FAQ: only datasheets that natively list Mission Tactics gain it; FAQ: Adaptive Tactics stratagem can grant Mission Tactics to other ADEPTUS ASTARTES units; army composition restrictions (Deathwatch-only, excluded units)

CERAMITE SENTINELS._engine_note: Verified from corpus (2026-08-23). Models attacking while their unit is within a terrain feature re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1. Units in terrain that were not set up this turn and moved no more than 3" gain the Entrenched keyword. Not modelled: rerolls are conditional on the unit being within a terrain feature; Entrenched keyword grant is conditional on terrain + no move over 3 inches + not deployed this turn; its effects live on unit datasheets, not expressible as a numeric modifier here

FIRESTORM ASSAULT FORCE._engine_note: Verified from corpus (2026-08-23). All army ranged weapons gain the Assault ability; attacks made with them add +1 to Strength when targeting a unit within 12". FULGURIS TASK FORCE._engine_note: Verified from corpus (2026-08-23). HEADHUNTER TASK FORCE._engine_note: Verified from corpus (2026-08-23). Vehicle units (excluding Fortifications, Drop Pods, Walkers, Flyers) become Tank Aces: their Advances are fixed 6" moves, and they may re-roll Damage rolls when shooting in a turn they did not Advance. Up to three Tank Ace units may gain the Character keyword at army muster. Not modelled: Damage reroll conditional on not Advancing this turn; fixed 6-inch Advance replaces (does not stack on) the Advance roll; Character keyword selection at muster enables Enhancements/Warlord, not a combat modifier; applies to vehicles only

IRONSTORM SPEARHEAD._engine_note: Verified from corpus (2026-08-23). Not modelled: reroll is a single die per unit per phase (player's choice of Hit/Wound/Damage), far weaker than a blanket reroll key would imply
